topics.text: Polls open on election day in East Coast states, including Washington, D.C.
Domenica Montanaro says independent voters could tip swing district races, with 46% GOP threshold
Trump gives closing pitch on National Mall, discussing reflecting pool renovations and election issues
Supreme Court hears case on whether Colorado pre-K program can exclude religious schools over LGBTQ policies
Steve Witkoff says US will mediate Ukraine-Russia working-level talks in Abu Dhabi next week
European grocery stores total damage after saboteurs hacked refrigeration systems and spoiled food
US removes South Africa and Rwanda from African Growth and Opportunity Act trade deal, effective January 1
Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in eastern India, following another cyclone last week
